name: Crop sprayer
description: Crop sprayers were starships used to dress barq fields after a harvest. The Grand Army of the Republic's Special Operations Brigade used a Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer to transport a group of clone commandos from the planet Ord Mantell to the planet Qiilura.
